sources.title: README.md · sahilchachra/Unlimited-OCR-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: GGUF quantizations of baidu/Unlimited-OCR, a 3B vision-language OCR model that pushes DeepSeek-OCR one step further (one-shot, long-horizon document parsing). This repo contains a full spread of K-quants and i-quants of the language model plus the vision projector (mmproj) needed for image input.

sources.title: Unlimited-OCR-GGUF: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Unlimited-OCR-GGUF is a quantized version of Baidu's Unlimited-OCR, a 3-billion-parameter vision-language model built for multilingual document parsing and optical character recognition.
